messages:
deploybot: Tag created: `v1.18.0-rc3` on commit `abcdef1234`. Planned rollout: canary (15m windows) -> staging -> prod. Short changelog: 1) reduce KV cache lock contention (infra); 2) small routing policy fix for region fallback (platform); 3) expose token metrics to console (observability). Canary starts in ~10m. See detailed changelog: https://git.redwood/inference/compare/1.18.0..v1.18.0-rc3 :rocket:
morgan: Nice — can you pin the changelog + release notes in this channel? Also tagging @release_manager for rollout approval.
deploybot: Pinned changelog and release notes to channel. Canary cohort: 5% traffic in us-east-1, 2% eu-west-1. Config summary (for ops):
```
TAG=v1.18.0-rc3
COMMIT=abcdef1234
COHORTS=[us-east-1:5%, eu-west-1:2%]
CANARY_WINDOW=900s
ROLLBACK_ON={error_rate:>2%, p95_latency:+>150ms}
```
sana: Quick question — what's the rollback workflow if we see a regression? Auto or manual?
release_manager: Auto-fallback kicks in if health checks fail or the `ROLLBACK_ON` thresholds hit. Ops will get a page and we run a dry-rollback then final rollback after sign-off within the 15m window. Manual rollback steps are in the pinned notes.
leo: Can we hold prod rollout for APAC until we confirm the quantized runtime metrics? Last time we saw a subtle perf bump there.
ops: Acknowledged — pausing prod propagation for ap-southeast-1. We'll fast-track if canary looks clean.
qa-bot: Running smoke suite against canary group now (tests: gen-smoke, latency-p95, token-consistency). ETA ~7m. Results will post back here automatically.
deploybot: Canary started @1743210600. Monitor IDs: monitor/canary/us-east-1 and monitor/canary/eu-west-1.
qa-bot: Smoke suite passed in us-east-1; p95 latency stable, no increase in error rate. eu-west-1 still running.
qa-bot: eu-west-1 done — all checks pass.
release_manager: Given green checks, proceeding to staggered staging push in 10m; holding APAC until leo/ops give thumbs.
morgan: Please pin a brief note for product about the feature flags included so PMs can coordinate canary users.
deploybot: Staging push complete @1743212400. Prod rollout scheduled; APAC remains held.
ops: Final status: prod rollout started to us/eu only at 1743213000. No anomalies observed in first 30m. Leaving APAC on hold as requested.
release_manager: Thanks all — marking `v1.18.0-rc3` as released to targeted regions. If anything regresses, follow pinned rollback playbook and notify #incidents. :thumbsup:
